items.title: How much does each additional trained person cut stall risk?
items.description: At the start of L1's Scenario, only Priya (1 person) can run the billing reconciliation job independently. Drag the number of people who could operate it independently (a real 2 or higher on L2's knowledge map) and watch the illustrative risk that nobody is available to keep it running on any given day. Each additional independently-trained person doesn't just add one more person — it cuts the odds that *everyone* capable is unavailable at the same time, which is why the drop is steep at first and flattens out fast.

params.name: peopleIndependentlyTrained
params.label: People who could run it independently

items.compute: const p = params.peopleIndependentlyTrained; const stallRisk = p === 0 ? 100 : Math.max(1, Math.round(100 / Math.pow(3, p))); return { stallRisk };

outputs.label: Illustrative chance nobody can run it on a given day
